title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description: Find the longest palindromic substring using expand-around-center.

data.text: Given a string `s`, return the longest palindromic substring in `s`.

data.title: Check all substrings O(n^3)
Expand O(n^2) O(1)
What improved?
data.text: We expand from each center instead of checking every substring. Each center expands outward, reducing repeated palindrome checks.
